flag_meanings.palette_drift: mean colour >= palette_distance_flag from nearest skin colour (hue+lightness)
flag_meanings.duplicate: mean |RGB| difference on a 16x16 grid below the skin's duplicate threshold (pixdiff_dup, or pixdiff_dup_flat_skin for minimal) vs another genre in this skin
flag_meanings.calibration_note: near_blank must not flag the approved pilot minimal/minimal-techno (luma_std 11.33, 825 colours), hence min_std_luma=6.0
flag_meanings.not_pixelated: pixel skin only: unique_colors_full > pixel_max_unique_smooth AND edge_hardness < pixel_min_edge_hardness

_header.calibration: thresholds tuned against the 18 approved pilot images so none are flagged
_header.note: flags are evidence, not verdicts; the verdict is the visual contact-sheet review
